adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb#fetch_http, the code calls `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase` without an explicit `present?` guard, unlike Jobs::PollFeed#execute which gates on `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?`. As written it will quietly no-op when the setting is the empty-string default (querying for username_lower: '' and returning if user.blank?), so it’s not a concrete defect from the diff, but it is an inconsistency/robustness issue and could raise if the setting were ever nil.
